records.source: ``"0.4"`` (the default; zarr-format 2, written by this module alone) or ``"0.5"`` (zarr-format 3, sharded by default, written through :mod:`zarr`, so it needs ``spacr[zarr]``; item 983). With 0.5 the default ``compressor`` is zstd at ``compression_level`` 3 unless another one is named; ``"lz4"`` (Blosc LZ4 with byte shuffle) is also offered there. ``"0.6"`` writes the same arrays as 0.5 with the 0.6 metadata (item 1007): the version only at ``ome.version``, the axes as the coordinate system ``"physical"``, and each level's transformation with ``{"path"}`` and ``{"name"}`` endpoints (see :func:`multiscale_to_ngff06`).
records.context: ``"0.4"`` (the default; zarr-format 2, written by this module alone) or ``"0.5"`` (zarr-format 3, sharded by default, written through :mod:`zarr`, so it needs ``spacr[zarr]``; item 983). With 0.5 the default ``compressor`` is zstd at ``compression_level`` 3 unless another one is named; ``"lz4"`` (Blosc LZ4 with byte shuffle) is also offered there. ``"0.6"`` writes the same arrays as 0.5 with the 0.6 metadata (item 1007): the version only at ``ome.version``, the axes as the coordinate system ``"physical"``, and each level's transformation with ``{"path"}`` and ``{"name"}`` endpoints (see :func:`multiscale_to_ngff06`).
records.translation: ``"0.4"`` (기본값, zarr-format 2, 이 모듈에서만 기록) 또는 ``"0.5"`` (zarr-format 3, 기본적으로 샤딩하며 :mod:`zarr` 를 통해 기록하므로 ``spacr[zarr]`` 가 필요함, 항목 983) 입니다. 0.5 에서는 다른 압축기를 지정하지 않으면 기본 ``compressor`` 는 zstd 이고 ``compression_level`` 은 3 입니다. 여기서는 ``"lz4"`` (바이트 셔플을 사용하는 Blosc LZ4) 도 제공합니다. ``"0.6"`` 은 0.5 와 같은 배열을 0.6 메타데이터로 기록합니다(항목 1007). 버전은 ``ome.version`` 에만 두고, 축은 ``"physical"`` 좌표계로 표현하며, 각 레벨의 변환에는 ``{"path"}`` 와 ``{"name"}`` 끝점을 사용합니다(:func:`multiscale_to_ngff06` 참조).
